# Video script: Which mode, for which question

> DRAFT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE. Contains claims with status 'ai-extracted' that no clinician has verified.

Unit F1 | Target length: 6 min

| # | Shot | Narration | Claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Presenter to camera | Each mode answers a different question about the heart. Structure, flow, speed, timing. | - |
| 2 | Machine console: preset and mode keys | Start in two-dimensional imaging. Narrow the sector and keep the frame rate above thirty to forty. | AS23-007 |
| 3 | Four-chamber clip, grey-scale then colour side by side | Colour shows that blood flows, and which way. Set the scale to the flow you want. Keep the grey-scale beside it. | AS23-009, AS23-010, IS23-041 |
| 4 | Pulmonary vein on colour, then power Doppler | For small vessels and slow flow, power Doppler helps. | AS23-011 |
| 5 | Screen capture: sample gate placed on a valve, spectral trace below | Pulsed-wave Doppler gives the flow pattern at one point. Line up with the flow. Small gate. | AS23-012 |
| 6 | M-mode trace with atrial and ventricular walls labelled | For rhythm, M-mode through an atrial wall and a ventricular wall shows which contracts when. | AS23-017 |
| 7 | Screen: thermal and mechanical index display | Keep exposure as low as reasonably achievable. Watch the indices, most of all early in pregnancy. | AS23-005, AS23-006 |
